name: Martial Arts
description: This works while you are unarmed or using only monk weapons (shortswords and simple melee weapons without two-handed or heavy), with no armor or shield. Use Dexterity for attack and damage if you like, and roll the Martial Arts die in place of the usual damage die.
Bonus action: one extra unarmed strike, available when your Attack action used an unarmed strike or a monk weapon.

name: Ki
uses: Refill on short or long rest
description: Ki points pay for your ki features, 1 point each unless a card says otherwise. A short or long rest brings them all back (meditate for at least 30 minutes).
Your ki save DC is 8 plus your proficiency bonus plus your Wisdom modifier.

name: Flurry of Blows
trigger: Right after you take the Attack action
description: Right after you take the Attack action, spend 1 ki point to throw two unarmed strikes using your bonus action.

name: Patient Defense
description: Spend 1 ki point to Dodge with your bonus action: attacks against you have disadvantage and your Dexterity saves have advantage until your next turn.

name: Step of the Wind
description: Spend 1 ki point and use your bonus action to Disengage or Dash. Your jump distance is also doubled for the turn.

name: Deflect Missiles
trigger: A ranged weapon attack hits you
resource: 1 ki point (optional, to throw the missile back)
description: When a ranged weapon attack hits you, roll 1d10, add your Dexterity modifier and monk level, and subtract the total from the damage.

If that takes the damage to 0 and the missile is small enough to hold, and you have a free hand, you catch it. You may then spend 1 ki point to fire it back right away, within the same reaction. You are proficient with it, and it counts as a monk weapon.

name: Slow Fall
description: When you fall, reduce the falling damage by 5 times your monk level.

name: Stunning Strike
trigger: You hit with a melee weapon attack
description: After a melee weapon hit, spend 1 ki point to try to stun the target. On a failed Constitution save (your ki save DC) it is stunned until your next turn ends.

name: Stillness of Mind
description: Use your action to end one charm or fear effect that is on you.
It ends only one effect per use.

name: Diamond Soul
description: Spend 1 ki point to reroll a saving throw you just failed. You must take the new result.
You are also proficient in all saving throws (always on).

name: Empty Body
description: Spend 4 ki points to turn invisible for 1 minute. While invisible you resist every damage type except force.
Or spend 8 ki points to cast astral projection with no material components. You cannot bring other creatures along.

name: Perfect Self
trigger: You roll initiative with 0 ki points
description: If you roll initiative with no ki points left, you get 4 ki points back.
